description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and MRR@10 for different DPR models. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" with a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot displays six lines representing different DPR models: DPR w/o query (black, solid line), DPR w/ gold (yellow, solid line with circle markers), DPR w/ top-1 (green, solid line with circle markers), DPR w/ bottom-1 (purple, dashed line with circle markers), DPR w/ random (blue, solid line with circle markers), and DPR w/ curriculum (red, solid line with circle markers). The black line remains steady at approximately 34.1 across the x-axis. The yellow line starts at a value below 33.0 at x=1, then increases to around 34.7 at x=10. The green line begins at a value below 33.0 at x=1, rises to 35.6 at x=4, and continues to increase to 36.3 at x=10. The purple dashed line remains relatively stable around 34.7 across the x-axis. The blue line starts at approximately 35.1 at x=1, peaks at 35.6 at x=2, and then gradually decreases to 35.3 at x=10. The red line begins at around 35.4 at x=1, increases to 35.7 at x=2, and then remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 35.8 at x=10.
